meta.name: azure-messaging
meta.description: Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Azure Messaging SDKs for Event Hubs and Service Bus. Covers connection failures, authentication errors, message processing issues, and SDK configuration problems. copy.tagline: 排查并修复Azure消息服务SDK的连接与处理故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在使用Azure事件中心或服务总线时遇到SDK错误需要快速定位
copy.tagline_en: Troubleshoot and fix Azure messaging SDK connection and processing issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter SDK errors with Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus and need quick diagnosis

howto.what: 装好后，当你报告 Azure 消息服务 SDK（Event Hubs 或 Service Bus）的异常时，Claude 会按流程排查：查看资源健康、核对错误信息、查 Microsoft Learn 文档、检查配置（连接串、实体名、消费组），再给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当你提到 Event Hubs 或 Service Bus 的 SDK 报错，比如连接失败、认证错误、消息锁丢失，或是询问如何开启日志、调 SDK 配置时。

say.text: Event Hub 的 Python 客户端连不上，报 AMQP 错误。
say.note: Claude 会检查资源健康、查文档并给出修复步骤。

say.text: Service Bus 队列的消息锁总是过期，怎么处理？
say.note: Claude 会针对锁过期给出配置建议。

say.text: 怎么为 Event Hub 开启诊断日志？
say.note: Claude 会提供开启方法及查询方式。

howto.what_en: Claude troubleshoots Azure Event Hubs/Service Bus SDK issues (connection, auth, message processing, config) by checking resource health, matching errors to docs, verifying settings, and offering fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe Event Hubs or Service Bus SDK errors, such as connection failures, authentication errors, message lock lost, or ask about logging/configuration.

say_en.text: My Event Hub Python client keeps failing to connect with an AMQP error.
say_en.note: Claude checks health and docs, then suggests steps.

say_en.text: Service Bus queue messages keep losing locks on the receiver side.
How do I enable diagnostic logging for Event Hub?
say_en.note: Claude shows how to enable and query logs.
